thread:
alex: Heads up — audit logs show a dev backup snapshot uploaded to a private S3 bucket contained a YAML dump with KMS-wrapped vault backup keys and a couple of short-lived service tokens. looks like a staging engineer accidentally included it in a manual backup.
priya: ugh. which bucket/backup? can we isolate? :eyes:
alex: s3://redwood-backups/dev-manual-2026-03-18.tar.gz. found by the data-loss-detector job at 09:12 UTC. object ACL is private but bucket has a couple of old cross-account read policies.
ben: ok first step: copy object to quarantine-bucket, remove public/cross-account policies, and rotate any exposed creds. doing that now.
vault-bot: [automated] object copy to s3://quarantine/redwood-backups/dev-manual-2026-03-18.tar.gz completed by ben at 09:25 UTC. version id preserved.
june: do we know which keys were in the YAML? KMS key IDs or vault key UUIDs?
alex: snippet from the dump looks like:
```
kms_wrapped_key: CiQA...wrapping-key: projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/backup-keys/cryptoKeys/backup-main
vault_sealed_key: sealed:0a1b2c3d... (vault namespace: dev-backups)
service_tokens:
  - name: ci-temp
    token: st-abc123 (expires 2026-03-20T12:00:00Z)
```
priya: ci-temp is a short-lived token used by an internal job. i'll revoke it immediately. tagging infra-oncall. @ben can you confirm revocation path?
ben: running: `vault token-revoke st-abc123` now. also adding a deny policy to the dev S3 bucket to block cross-account reads until we audit policies.
alex: we should also rewrap the KMS key and re-seal the vault backup. if the KMS key resource name leaked, principle-of-least-trust says rewrap. any downtime impact?
ben: rewrap plan: create a new cryptoKey version on backup-main, call `projects/*/cryptoKeys/versions/patch` to set primary, then re-encrypt backup blobs. 1) create new key version 2) rewrap wrapped keys in the vault backup 3) update vault sealed secrets with new wrapped blobs. can do with zero downtime for runtime, just needs coordination with vault-ops.
june: timeline? customer-facing services unaffected but want to avoid failing restores.
priya: propose schedule: immediate mitigation (revoke tokens + quarantine) done. tonight at 02:00 UTC: create new KMS key version, rewrap and generate new sealed backup, push to quarantine and mark old backup deprecated. post-ops checks at 03:00.
alex: add RBAC step: audit IAM bindings on the KMS key and remove any long-lived cross-account service accounts. Ben, can you produce the IAM diff and who recently had access?
ben: will run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and diff against our saved policy. will post results in this thread in 10m.
vault-bot: [automated alert] detected vault unseal attempts from unexpected IP 203.0.113.45 at 09:28 UTC — currently blocked by WAF.
priya: good catch. is that related to the backup leak? can we confirm?
alex: probably unrelated but worth checking. prioritize rewrap + revoke. I'll open a short incident ticket and tag SOC for network correlation.
june: do we need to rotate any customer-facing certificates or is scope internal dev backups only?
ben: looks internal-only per token names and vault namespace. still, rotate any credentials that used that ci-temp token in CI jobs — i.e., the dev-k8s-cluster service account.
priya: i'll coordinate rollout: create new SA keys (ephemeral), update CI jobs to use short-lived tokens via workload identity federation, retire service account keys. steps in checklist: 
- revoke exposed tokens (done)
- quarantine backup (done)
- create new KMS key version (scheduled 02:00 UTC)
- rewrap vault backup and reseal (02:15 UTC)
- publish new backup to secure bucket with strict IAM (02:30 UTC)
- update CI to use WF tokens and remove long-lived keys (by EOD)
- run restore test from new backup (03:00 UTC)
- postmortem and controller process update (tomorrow)
alex: please add an audit log search to ensure no one downloaded that object in last 30 days. Ben/priya can you request S3 access logs and CloudTrail for the bucket?
ben: grabbing access logs now. will paste any GET/GETOBJECT events.
june: if anyone else touched the backup, rotate those accounts too. also add a short blurb for legal/compliance.
priya: adding legal and SOC to the ticket. tagging @legal-team for required notification timing.
alex: thanks all. small ask — after rotation, let's add an automated pre-backup linter to scan for PEM / vault/wrapped strings and fail backups that contain them. low effort, high ROI.
ben: agree. i'll add a pre-upload hook to the backup job. small regex check and a deny if matched.
priya: updating postmortem template now. will include timeline and lessons: RBAC hygiene, pre-backup linting, and WF adoption.
june: looks like action items covered. ping here when rewrap completes and when new backup published.
vault-bot: [automated] follow-up: scheduled rewrap job created for 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z. assigned to ben, priy a.
alex: closing note — thanks for the quick triage. keep this thread as the single source of truth for the incident until postmortem published. :thumbsup:
